newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia palm olein edges down in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia palm olein edges down in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were lower in late trading on Wednesday on weak demand despite gains in Malaysia, traders said.

They said palm olein was quoted at 1,380-85 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, down from 1,385-90 rupiah at the opening, but offers were also heard at 1,375 rupiah. Crude palm oil was last done at 1,165 rupiah in the North Sumatran city of Medan on Tuesday.

"Players are keen on buying but are waiting for prices to hit bottom," one trader said. "Buyers are waiting because some players are quoting prices at below the market range, giving the impression prices could decline further."
The traders said a strong performance in Malaysia should help lift sentiment on Thursday.
"Some players closed early today following the increases in Malaysia because they probably would want to raise prices tomorrow," one trader said.
Another trader said he was hoping to raise the price to 1,390-95 rupiah/kg on Thursday, but added that he would also be watching other players' offer levels.
"I think demand should improve tomorrow because of gains in Malaysia," he added.
